APPLICATION NOTICE
How your data is handled
local-demo-v1
Verified plain text
One The Go is a measurement platform. This release does not determine whether you are intoxicated or safe to drive.

Demo chemistry, eye, pulse, ECG and alcohol examples are fictional. A native reaction task records your actual taps as uncalibrated practice; those taps are not fictional and have not been validated to measure impairment. Camera positioning preview neither records images nor measures pupils.

Guest demo records stay on this device and never upload or migrate when you sign in. Native records use encrypted local storage. The web preview keeps data only in memory. Export happens only after your explicit selection and share action. Anyone receiving an exported file may be able to read it.

Age, height, weight and context are optional. They do not generate a metabolic rate, clearance time or impairment score. Profile context freezes when you select Start check.

Qualified sensors, research enrollment and raw recording require their own approved configuration and permissions; this release ships no approved human assay or active impairment model. Account notice acknowledgment is separate from research consent.
